has accumulated benefitdp back to ToC or Data Property ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#hasAccumulatedBenefit

Accumulated benefit of a hypothetical index: sum of its records. After its real index is removed it starts again from -hasEstimatedCreationCost and counts only the executions after the removal (Morelli, section 3.3).

has characteristics: functional

has domain
Access Structure c
has range
float

has accumulated bonusdp back to ToC or Data Property ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#hasAccumulatedBonus

Accumulated benefit of a real index (Morelli, section 3.2): hasInitialAccumulatedBonus + the RealIndexBonus and IndexUpdateCost records of the executions after its creation (or after its last rebuild). Below -hasEstimatedCreationCost the index is removed (or rebuilt).

has characteristics: functional

has domain
Access Structure c
has range
float

has estimated creation costdp back to ToC or Data Property ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#hasEstimatedCreationCost

CCI = 2P + c R log2 R (Salles, 2002, section 4.5.1): read the P pages of the table and write the same number of index pages, plus sorting the R tuples. In plan cost units (one page I/O = 1). Copied to the real index when it is created; -CCI is its elimination threshold.

Access Structure c

hasDate + hasTime (00:00:00 when there is no time), computed by Rule_IndexBenefit_Timestamp. Puts executions and executed actions in order: an execution counts for a real index only between the creation (or the last rebuild) and the removal of the index.

is disjoint with
Column ni, Storage Area Component ni, Table ni
is also defined as
class

Action Create Hypothetical Indexni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_CreateHypotheticalIndex

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Create Hypothetical Index ni
has description dp "create hypothetical index % on %(%);"
has justification dp "As the index is no longer beneficial to the database (Benefit: % x Creation cost: %), it was removed and kept only in the metabase."

Action Create Real Indexni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_CreateRealIndex

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Create Real Index ni
has description dp "create index % on %(%);"
has justification dp "The index has an estimated benefit of %, which exceeds its estimated creation cost of %. Statements that generated the benefits: %."

Action Create Real Materialized Viewni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_CreateRealMaterializedView

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Real Materialized View ni
has DBA decision dp "true"^^boolean
has description dp "create materialized view %"
has justification dp "The hypothetical materialized view has an estimated positive benefit of %, which in absolute value exceeds its estimated creation cost of %."
was executed dp "false"^^boolean

Action Drop Hypothetical Indexni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_DropHypotheticalIndex

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Drop Hypothetical Index ni
has description dp "drop hypothetical index %;"
has justification dp "As the index proved beneficial to the database (Benefit: % x Creation cost: %), it was removed as hypothetical and created as a real index in the database."

Action Drop Real Indexni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_DropRealIndex

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Drop Real Index ni
has description dp "drop index %;"
has justification dp "The index has an estimated negative benefit of %, which in absolute value exceeds its estimated creation cost of %. Statements that caused the losses: %."

Action Materialized View Benefits Heuristicni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_MaterializedViewBenefitsHeuristic

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Real Materialized View ni
has DBA decision dp "true"^^boolean
has description dp "MaterializedViewBenefitsHeuristic"
has justification dp "This materialized view has an estimated benefit of <MaterializedView.accumulatedBenefit>, which exceeds its estimated creation cost of <MaterializedView.creationCost>. Statements that generated the benefits: <MaterializedView.benefitedStatements>"
was executed dp "false"^^boolean

Action Materialized View Candidates Heuristicni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

belongs to

has facts
is performed by op Function Hypothetical Materialized View ni

has description dp "MaterializedViewCandidatesHeuristic"
has justification dp "The SQL query <Query> was rewritten to make it generic and usable by other queries with the same structure but different parameters. As a consequence, the hypothetical materialized view with the following syntax was suggested: <DDL Create View>"
was executed dp "false"^^boolean

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Real Materialized View ni

has description dp "MaterializedViewExpectationHeuristic"
has justification dp "This materialized view has an estimated execution cost of <MaterializedView.estimatedExecutionCost>, while the original query costs <Query.executionCost>. Therefore, the estimated saving each time the materialized view is used may be <MaterializedView.executionGain>"
was executed dp "false"^^boolean

Action Rebuild Real Indexni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Action_RebuildRealIndex

belongs to
Action c
has facts
is performed by op Function Rebuild Real Index ni
has description dp "alter index % set (fillfactor = %); reindex index %;"
has justification dp "The accumulated bonus of the index, %, is below its elimination cost, %, but the index is fragmented (GrF %) and was useful in % scans: rebuild it with fill factor % instead of dropping it."

Rule Clause Membershipni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Clause_Membership

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Links each clause and its statement in both directions (hasClause / isClauseOf)."
has name dp "Clause_Membership"

Rule Column Inserted Columnsni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Column_InsertedColumns

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "An INSERT INTO clause without a column list references every column of its table."
has name dp "Column_InsertedColumns"

Rule Column Qualified Referenceni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Column_QualifiedReference

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Turns each table.column reference of a clause into the Column of that table (referencesColumn, ReferencedColumn), creating the column if the table does not have it."
has name dp "Column_QualifiedReference"

Rule Column Unqualified Referenceni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Column_UnqualifiedReference

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Turns each column reference without table into the column with that name of the only table, among those of the FROM clauses of the statement and of the statements around it, that has it."
has name dp "Column_UnqualifiedReference"

Rule Comparison Operator Linkni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_ComparisonOperator_Link

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Links each atomic expression to the ComparisonOperator with its symbol, creating the operator if the symbol is new."
has name dp "ComparisonOperator_Link"

Rule D M L Statement Classificationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_DMLStatement_Classification

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Types each statement by its clauses: UpdateClause -> UpdateStatement, InsertIntoClause -> InsertStatement, DeleteFromClause -> DeleteStatement, otherwise SelectClause -> QueryStatement."
has name dp "DMLStatement_Classification"

Rule D M L Statement Compositionni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_DMLStatement_Composition

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Links each statement and its subqueries in both directions (hasComponentStatement / isComponentStatementOf) and types it CompositeStatement (it has subqueries) or AtomicStatement."
has name dp "DMLStatement_Composition"

Rule Hypothetical Index Column Groupsni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_HypotheticalIndex_ColumnGroups

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Puts the columns of each query block in the groups of Salles (2002, section 4.5.1): EQ (equality with a value), O (ORDER BY, GROUP BY, join predicates), RANGE (between, <, <=, >, >=) and SARG (like, in)."
has name dp "HypotheticalIndex_ColumnGroups"

Rule Hypothetical Index Group Combinationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_HypotheticalIndex_GroupCombination

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Create Hypothetical Index ni
has description dp "For each query block and table, suggests the hypothetical indexes EQ+O, EQ+O+RANGE, EQ+O+RANGE+SARG, EQ+O+RANGE+REF, O+EQ, O+EQ+RANGE, O+EQ+RANGE+SARG and O+EQ+RANGE+REF (two or more columns, no repeated column, columns of a group in table order), as in Salles (2002), section 4.5.1."
has name dp "HypotheticalIndex_GroupCombination"

Rule Hypothetical Index Referenced Columnsni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_HypotheticalIndex_ReferencedColumns

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Group REF: the other columns referenced by the query block (SELECT, WHERE, HAVING, GROUP BY, ORDER BY)."
has name dp "HypotheticalIndex_ReferencedColumns"

Rule Hypothetical Index Single Columnni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_HypotheticalIndex_SingleColumn

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Create Hypothetical Index ni
has description dp "Suggests a single-column hypothetical index for each column of the groups EQ, O, RANGE and SARG."
has name dp "HypotheticalIndex_SingleColumn"

Rule Index Benefit Accumulatedni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexBenefit_Accumulated

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Accumulated benefit of each hypothetical index = sum of its records; after its real index is removed, -CCI plus the records of the later executions (Morelli, section 3.3). Usage count = executions that used it."
has name dp "IndexBenefit_Accumulated"

Rule Index Benefit Creation Costni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexBenefit_CreationCost

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Creation cost of each hypothetical index (Salles, 2002, section 4.5.1): CCI = 2P + c R log2 R, P and R the pages and tuples of the table, c the I/O-CPU cost coefficient of the DBMS."
has name dp "IndexBenefit_CreationCost"

Rule Index Benefit Execution Benefitni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexBenefit_ExecutionBenefit

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "For each DML statement execution and each hypothetical index the statement originates (while the index is not real), records a HypotheticalPlanBenefit: +(real plan total cost - hypothetical plan total cost) if the hypothetical plan uses the index, the same value negated otherwise."
has name dp "IndexBenefit_ExecutionBenefit"

Rule Index Benefit Timestampni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexBenefit_Timestamp

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Timestamp (hasDate + hasTime) of each DML statement execution and of each executed action, to put them in order."
has name dp "IndexBenefit_Timestamp"

Rule Index Benefit Update Costni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexBenefit_UpdateCost

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "For each INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE execution and each index it affects (every index of the table for INSERT and DELETE, the indexes with a SET column for UPDATE), hypothetical or real, records an IndexUpdateCost of -CA, CA = 2 x ceil(r / R x P) + c x r (Salles, 2002, section 4.5.1)."
has name dp "IndexBenefit_UpdateCost"

Rule Index Rebuild Decisionni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexRebuild_Decision

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Rebuild Real Index ni
has description dp "When a real index is about to be removed but is fragmented (GrF, blocks and scans above the thresholds of the heuristic), proposes a REINDEX with fill factor 10 - ((V + 10) div 10) instead of the DROP (Morelli, figures 4.4 and 4.13)."
has name dp "IndexRebuild_Decision"

Rule Index Rebuild Fragmentation Degreeni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_IndexRebuild_FragmentationDegree

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Fragmentation degree GrF = 100 - (Ra / Ri) x 100 and number of useful scans V of each real index (Morelli, chapter 4)."
has name dp "IndexRebuild_FragmentationDegree"

Rule Literal Creationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Literal_Creation

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Creates the Literal with the value on the right of an atomic expression (hasLiteralValue) and makes it the right operand."
has name dp "Literal_Creation"

Rule Logical Connector Linkni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_LogicalConnector_Link

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Links each composite expression to the LogicalConnector with its word (and, or), creating it if the word is new."
has name dp "LogicalConnector_Link"

Rule M V Accumulated Benefitni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_AccumulatedBenefit

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "HyGainACVM: sum of the MaterializedViewBenefit records of the view (figure 17, line 7)."
has name dp "MV_AccumulatedBenefit"

Rule M V Compatibilityni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_Compatibility

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "A basic query is compatible with a view when it has the same tables and every field it projects, filters or groups by and every aggregate it computes is in the view (Weberling, section 2.7)."
has name dp "MV_Compatibility"

Rule M V Creation By Benefitsni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_CreationByBenefits

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Materialized View Benefits Heuristic ni
has description dp "When HyGainACVM > CreationCostVM (figure 17, line 8), creates the real MaterializedView (derives), the CreateMaterializedViewStatement and an Action with the justification for the DBA."
has name dp "MV_CreationByBenefits"

Rule M V Creation By Expectationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_CreationByExpectation

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Materialized View Expectation Heuristic ni
has description dp "When the view fits in the disk space left for tuning (EDR > CE) and the processing share of the query is above X% (Oliveira, rule 4-2), creates a real MaterializedView (derives), the CreateMaterializedViewStatement and an Action with the justification, whatever the frequency of the query."
has name dp "MV_CreationByExpectation"

Rule M V Define Viewni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_DefineView

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Materialized View Candidates Heuristic ni
has description dp "MountVM and DefineView (Weberling, figures 14 and 15): for each basic query whose tables form an interesting subset, a hypothetical materialized view over the same tables and joins, projecting the fields, filter fields and HAVING aggregates of the query, grouped by its non-aggregated fields; the view is formulated by a RewrittenQueryStatement the query originates. The same definition is the same view (Merge, figure 16)."
has name dp "MV_DefineView"

Rule M V Estimated Creation Costni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_EstimatedCreationCost

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "CreationCostVM = Cost(ClauseVM) + 2 x HyPgVM: computing the definition and writing the pages of the view."
has name dp "MV_EstimatedCreationCost"

Rule M V Execution Benefitni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_ExecutionBenefit

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "For each execution and each of its queries or subqueries compatible with a view, records a MaterializedViewBenefit HyGainVM = Cost(q) - HyCost(q) (Weberling, figure 17, lines 3-5)."
has name dp "MV_ExecutionBenefit"

Rule M V Expected Gainni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_ExpectedGain

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "For each hypothetical materialized view: CRC, the real cost of the query it was defined from in its most recent execution, QPL, the pages that execution read, and (CRC - QPL) x 100 / CRC, the share of the cost that is processing (Oliveira, rule 4-4)."
has name dp "MV_ExpectedGain"

Rule M V Full Scan Costni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_FullScanCost

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "HyCost = HyRowVM x SizeRowVM x fill factor / page size: cost of a full scan of the view (Hose et al.)."
has name dp "MV_FullScanCost"

Rule M V Hypothetical Page Countni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_HypotheticalPageCount

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "HyPgVM = HyRowVM x SizeRowVM / page size (HyRowVM from the plan of the definition of the view)."
has name dp "MV_HypotheticalPageCount"

Rule M V Interesting Table Subsetni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_InterestingTableSubset

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "InterestingTableSubsets (Weberling, figure 8): TS-Cost(T) = total cost of the queries and subqueries of the workload whose tables include T; TS-Weight(T) = sum of Cost(Qi) x sizeTables(T) / sizeTablesClause(Qi); T is interesting when both reach C = workload fraction x total cost of the workload."
has name dp "MV_InterestingTableSubset"

Rule M V Table Subsetni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_TableSubset

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Creates the TableSubset of the tables of each query and subquery (TS in Agrawal et al., 2000)."
has name dp "MV_TableSubset"

Rule M V Table Subset Sizeni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_TableSubsetSize

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "sizeTables(T): sum of the page counts of the tables of each table subset."
has name dp "MV_TableSubsetSize"

Rule M V Tuple Sizeni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_MV_TupleSize

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "SizeRowVM: sum of the maximum sizes of the columns of the view, plus the aggregate column size for each aggregate."
has name dp "MV_TupleSize"

Rule Predicate Classificationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Predicate_Classification

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Types each predicate: with an operator symbol -> AtomicExpression, with a connector word -> CompositeExpression."
has name dp "Predicate_Classification"

Rule Predicate Operandsni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_Predicate_Operands

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Links the left and right operands of each atomic expression to the columns of its WHERE clause."
has name dp "Predicate_Operands"

Rule Real Index Accumulated Bonusni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_RealIndex_AccumulatedBonus

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Accumulated bonus of each real index = initial accumulated bonus + its records after the creation or the last rebuild (Morelli, section 3.2)."
has name dp "RealIndex_AccumulatedBonus"

Rule Real Index Creationni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_RealIndex_Creation

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Create Real Index ni
has description dp "When the accumulated benefit of a hypothetical index exceeds its estimated creation cost, creates the real index (Index, linked by becomes) with bonus = accumulated benefit / executions that used it and initial accumulated bonus = accumulated benefit (Morelli, section 3.2), the CreateIndexStatement that creates it and an Action with the justification for the DBA."

Rule Real Index Lifecycleni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_RealIndex_Lifecycle

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "Creation, last rebuild and removal timestamps and status (dbaDecision, created, removed) of each real index, from the actions the dispatcher executed."
has name dp "RealIndex_Lifecycle"

Rule Real Index Removalni back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_RealIndex_Removal

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
generates action op Action Drop Real Index ni
has description dp "When the accumulated bonus of an existing real index falls below its elimination cost (-CCI) and no rebuild is pending, creates the DropIndexStatement that removes it and an Action with the justification for the DBA (Morelli, sections 3.3 and 3.4)."

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_RealIndex_UnusedPenalty

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "For each execution of a statement that originated a real index whose real plan does not use it, records a RealIndexBonus of -bonus. Extension to Morelli: switch it off (isEnabled false) to decrement only on updates."

is enabled dp "true"^^boolean

IRI: http://www.owl-ontologies.com/onDBTuning.owl#Rule_RealIndex_UsageBonus

belongs to
Rule c
has facts
has description dp "For each execution whose real plan uses a real index, records a RealIndexBonus of +bonus (Morelli, figure 3.4, line 9)."
has name dp "RealIndex_UsageBonus"
